workflowInput.requestedWork: Train a reusable arbitrary-source style-transfer prompt with optional-instruction handling and leakage-resistant overfitting checks.
acceptanceCriteria: The reusable prompt contains zero source-specific hard-coded clauses.
Frozen validation covers baseline, pose, composition, and exact text across two unseen source hashes.
Exact requested text is rendered verbatim and absent text produces no added typography.
Aggregate, worst-case, and generalization-gap thresholds pass on validation and sealed test.
No pre-validation node opens the validation manifest and no pre-audit node opens the test manifest.
All generation and judge models, prompts, hashes, and loss components are persisted.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths in persisted artifacts.
Use the built-in image generation tool.
Do not open validationManifest before validate-transferability.
Do not open sealedTestManifest before audit-generalization.
Do not modify completed train-0001 through train-0003 evidence or failed train-0004 evidence.
Do not compare legacy identity-judge loss numerically with the new source-fidelity judge.
